mentions.name: Eyeball
mentions.description: A bookmarks assistant that provides a simple place to save all your links and find them via chat. The app automatically adds summaries to all saved links and sends a weekly update of what you saved every Sunday morning.

mentions.name: Eyeball
mentions.description: A bookmarks app that turns your own saved links into hyper-personalized playlists, acting like a personal curator that sends a weekly issue of your personal 'magazine' on Sundays.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building Eyeball - https://tryeyeball.com/

Eyeball is a bookmarks app that turns your own saved links into hyper-personalized playlists. It's like having a personal curator in your pocket that sends you a weekly issue of your own personal "magazine" on Sundays.
